item.title: How Ukraine struck the Kerch bridge, a symbol of Putin’s rule
item.description: With the SpaceX satellite system faltering, Ukraine’s military launched a surprise, multi-pronged attack to take down vital bridge to Crimea At 10pm on Monday evening a Ukrainian soldier scrawled a message on a kamikaze drone. Lines of ice had formed on the drone’s bulky wings. Soon, it would be hurtling towards its target – about 500km to the south.
